units.source_text: 掌柜从客栈派驻车站的接客处走出来，通知开始剪票了。

en.t: The innkeeper came out from the inn's reception desk at the station and announced that ticket inspection was beginning.

units.source_text: 只有四五个身穿灰色冬装的本地人在默默地上下车。

en.t: Only four or five local people in gray winter clothes silently got on and off the train.
